title: enhancement: Ensure a2a-server is compatible with V2 nested settings structure

triage_metadata.reasoning: The issue is a valid and actionable bug/compatibility report. It clearly describes that a2a-server fails to correctly handle the V2 nested settings structure (defined in settings.schema.json) when reading user configuration, and points directly to the TODO comment in packages/a2a-server/src/config/settings.ts.
triage_metadata.effort_reasoning: The required changes are localized within packages/a2a-server/src/config/settings.ts to update the Settings interface, implement migration and nested settings resolution, matching the pattern in packages/cli/src/config/settings.ts.

summary.problem: a2a-server lacks support for the V2 nested settings structure and legacy V1 migration logic, causing it to fail parsing user settings migrated by the main CLI.
summary.root_cause: packages/a2a-server/src/config/settings.ts only parses flat/V1 settings fields and lacks the migration and nested settings resolution logic present in packages/cli/src/config/settings.ts.
summary.context: When a user runs the main CLI, settings.json is migrated to the V2 nested structure defined in settings.schema.json. Subsequent execution of a2a-server fails to parse nested configuration options like telemetry, allowed/excluded tools, folder trust, and file filtering.

steps: Update the Settings interface in packages/a2a-server/src/config/settings.ts to incorporate V2 nested settings definitions.
Implement legacy V1 to V2 settings migration and key resolution logic within loadSettings.
Ensure nested configuration options are correctly extracted and merged between user and workspace settings.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: a2a-server successfully parses and merges both V2 nested settings structures and legacy V1 settings configurations.
verification_steps: Add unit tests in packages/a2a-server/src/config/settings.test.ts to test loadSettings with V2 nested settings.json files.
Add unit tests for fallback and migration when loading legacy V1 flat settings.json files.
Run tests using vitest run in packages/a2a-server to verify all tests pass.
